blocks.text: Synthesis mein target molecule saada, bazaar mein milne wale compounds se, kabhi kai qadmon mein, banaya jata hai. Maslan primary aliphatic amine halogenoalkane ko ammonia se react kara kar aik qadam mein ban sakta hai: R-CH2-Cl + NH3 -> R-CH2-NH2 + HCl. Halogenoalkanes aasani se nahi milte, lekin alcohols se bante hain jo milte hain, is liye amine alcohol se do qadmon mein ban sakta hai: R-CH2-OH + SOCl2 -> R-CH2-Cl, phir R-CH2-Cl + NH3 -> R-CH2-NH2 + HCl.

blocks.title: Reaction ke halaat
blocks.text: Kitab ammonia wale reaction ke teer par CCl4 likhti hai. Chapter 21 mein yeh substitution ethanol mein ammonia ke saath, pressure par garam kar ke ki jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Ethanol se ethanamine ki do qadmi synthesis batayein.
blocks.explanation: CH3CH2OH + SOCl2 -> CH3CH2Cl + SO2 + HCl; phir CH3CH2Cl + NH3 -> CH3CH2NH2 + HCl (ethanol mein zaid NH3, garmi, pressure).

items: Synthesis dastiyab compounds se aage barhti.
